speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: The Ministry of Trade and Industry (MTI) aims to create good jobs and opportunities for Singaporeans by growing a vibrant economy.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: As a small city-state with no direct hinterland, we need to have deep connections with the rest of the world.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: Trade and investment links allow us to do business in the region and throughout different parts of the world.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: Singapore has benefited from a rules-based open multilateral trading architecture by which nations have prospered.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: However, this has come under pressure as workers, particularly those in the more advanced economies, feel dislocated by technology and globalisation.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: Some countries have taken on more protectionist and nativist attitudes towards trade and investment.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: Today, we are among the best-connected air and sea hubs in the world.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will continue to invest in and ensure good physical connectivity to the rest of the world.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will also enhance our connectivity with the rest of the world in the non-physical dimensions.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We are one of the key financial hubs in the world and will strengthen our attributes to be a digital hub.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: These efforts will allow companies and people from around the world to do business with Singapore, through Singapore, and on Singapore platforms.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: Through excellent physical and digital connectivity, we can add value to the flows of capital, goods and services, not only when they are conducted in or through Singapore, but even when trade takes place elsewhere.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: Companies and people choose Singapore because they know they can trust Singapore and Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: When they sign a contract, they know it will be honoured and they can trust the rule of law.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: They site sensitive investments and valuable intellectual property here, because they know it will be protected.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will strengthen the nexus between our Research, Innovation and Enterprise 2020 Plan and our industry development plans to help enterprises innovate and grow.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will support enterprises to invest in research and development, and develop new and innovative product and service offerings.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will work with enterprises and our people to take advantage of our position at the heart of Asia.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: Asia is where the next billion middle-class consumers will be, and where our enterprises will find abundant growth opportunities.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We must develop a deep understanding of the region, not just economically, but also culturally.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: This way, we can carve out a niche as a place where companies and people seek to come, to understand and take advantage of the diversity of Asian consumer tastes and preferences.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: This will enable these enterprises to tap on the rising infrastructure demand in the region.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will also position Singapore as a test-bedding hub for startups developing new products, services and solutions for regional and global markets.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We must remain a trusted and well-connected hub for global multinational corporations (MNCs) seeking to tap on Asia’s growth.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: These MNCs will bring with them ideas, innovative capabilities and expertise to create new value for Asian markets based on our insights.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We seek also to be the go-to place for Asian MNCs that are taking their business global.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: Amidst these, MNCs, in working with local suppliers, will help to transfer knowledge to and deepen capabilities of our enterprises, and strengthen our corporate ecosystem.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: They will also create good jobs which will place our people at the forefront of developments for their industries.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: ESG will be enterprise-centric and walk with enterprises at different stages of their growth, including to tailor programmes to their specific needs.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: For example, we will simplify access to assistance programmes for small and medium enterprises (SMEs) looking to upgrade their capabilities, while providing more customised support for growth-oriented enterprises to deepen their capabilities and innovative capacities.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will also support our enterprises’ internationalisation efforts through our global networks and encourage partnerships among enterprises so that they are better placed to seize new opportunities and projects abroad.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: ESG and the Economic Development Board (EDB) will work closely with each other, and with other agencies, such as the Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR) and the Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA), to support enterprises in these endeavours.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: Our people are at the core of our economy.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: Our workers are motivated, cohesive and willing to learn.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: They are key to why we have been able to attract companies to invest in Singapore.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: The successful execution of our strategy depends on our people.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: With the opportunities ahead of us in Singapore and abroad, we will support our workers to take on challenging assignments in regional and global markets.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: Our students will be connected to the world; they will transcend borders and be inspired by new ideas.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: Our people will find exciting opportunities to pursue, and diverse talent with whom to collaborate.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will remain an open economy, with a pro-business, pro-competition and pro-innovation environment.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will meld the best ideas, talent and enterprises of the world in Singapore.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We can and will transform our economy, as all stakeholders pull together to create good jobs and opportunities for our people.
